一根线，每一拍送一位。从传一位话开始，一层层搭出能可靠地收发一帧的网卡。: One wire, one bit a tick. Start by passing a bit on, and build up, layer by layer, a network card that sends and receives a frame reliably.
线上每一拍送一位：怎样说，怎样听？: A bit on the wire each tick: how to speak, how to hear?
世界前进的一步：每一拍，每根线送一位，板上的电路算一遍。: One step of the world: each tick every wire carries one bit and the board computes once.
一根线每一拍送一位：0 或 1。: A wire carries one bit a tick: 0 or 1.
每一拍把左线上到达的位说到右线上。: Every tick, say on the right-hand wire the bit arriving on the left-hand wire.
板上的电路每一拍从头算一遍，算完什么也不留下。要留下一个值到下一拍，用一对新元件: The board computes afresh every tick and keeps nothing once done. To keep a value for the next tick there is a new pair of parts: <part-ref to="part:keep"></part-ref> stores a value in a register, and <part-ref to="part:reg"></part-ref> reads it out the next tick.
寄存卡让电路记得上一拍。: A register lets a circuit remember the tick before.
每一拍在右线上说出左线上一拍的位；第一拍说 0。: Every tick, say on the right-hand wire the bit the left-hand wire had the tick before; say 0 on the first tick.
